observations.element: Data sharing between the two libraries
observations.observed_result: The two libraries are separate data sets: image library = layer_images (REST /api/layer-images*, /api/layer-image-categories?type=clipart, GraphQL relay layer_images_connection, cursor pagination); mockup library = mockup_layers (REST /api/mockup-layers*, /api/mockup-layer-categories, Laravel offset pagination). While 11 QA- images existed in the image library, the mockup modal listed only its own 10 pre-existing items; the mockup uploads (4632-4637) never appeared in the image picker (verified by relay listing at ACT-01-10-004 containing only image-library records). Categories are also separate (image cat id 37 vs mockup cat id 18). Shared mechanics: same temporary-files/upload-url + CDN PUT step, same client polling pattern, same 422 message for non-image content, same 'You can't upload files of this type.' client message, same category dialog and confirm dialog components.

Observed only partial evidence: an empty image category shows the same 'Empty data' text as the Vector picker, and the dropzone stays usable in that state, so the image picker does not block adding by itself; whether 'Select' is blocked with 0 images remains unobserved. Also observed that VECTOR group now has items ('qa-vector' layers exist in 4087), so KB-048's empty-vector precondition no longer holds on this store.

suspected_issues.summary: Image rename accepts empty name: update_layer_images with name '' succeeds (200), card label becomes '...'. No client or server validation.
Single-image delete confirm shows empty name: 'Are you sure to remove ?' (image library shows the name).
Bulk selection persists across pages: on page 2 the 'Delete'/'Move to category'/'Select 6 images' buttons act on items not visible - risk of deleting unseen images.
'Move to category' with no category chosen is accepted (PUT /api/layer-images/move category_id null -> 200) - silently removes images from their category instead of validating.
Category name: Create button disabled only for empty string; whitespace-only enables it and relies on server 422 'The name field is required.' shown as generic 'Something went wrong!' toast.
No file size limit observed: 27 MB PNG accepted in both libraries (upload-url, PUT and by-temporary-file all succeed).
Counter text 'Showing 1 to 0 of 0 entries' on empty results.

DELETE /api/layer-images/{id} and POST in-use send the whole current (unsaved) artwork JSON as request body; in-use check is only against that body (layers reference image by url), so deleting an image used by a different saved artwork may not be blocked - unverified.
Rejected uploads (fake png) still create a temporary file on object storage (upload-url 201 + PUT 200 before server validation) - orphan files, no cleanup UI.
Single-card delete does not call POST /api/mockup-layers/in-use (bulk delete does) - possible inconsistency in usage protection between single and bulk delete.
